sections.Profile:
The "Magic Clock" pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in December 1960, is a two-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Leisure, Swimming, Dancing, Pool (Billiards), Sports, Original Theme, Time
